reviews.x: This tray is small & overpriced. Target has a boot tray that is almost identical in their dollar section. Walmart has a bigger cheaper boot tray in their store. I wish I hadn't been so impatient and just waited to get one until I had the time to run out. Don't waste your money.

I was a little disappointed in the stiffness of the plastic.  I had hoped for something a little more pliable.  The stiff plastic slides around on the hardwood floor a bit, but other than that, it does it's job.  Pine needles and raindrops are well contained in the 1" lip on the tray.

After searching every home renovation supply and accessory store looking for a boot tray that would fit in our humble vestibule I found my solution!! Just in time for some more snow!!! Can't wait for spring to really put it to good use. and it's just the right size..surprise!! We don't have a mcmansion and finding home accessories is hard as everything is sooo large.

This item was exactly as described - it's got a nice edge around the sides to catch water, and the ridges on the bottom of it allow your boots/shoes to sit just high enough that the snow/water drains and they dry quickly.  This is exactly what we needed!
item was good buy for the money. would have liked better if the product was thicker.

I got this because it was cheap, so I guess I got what I ordered.  The plastic is cheap and kind of flimsy, and the tray will probably only fit about two pairs of adult winter boots.  The ridges are a little low.  I had previously spent twice as much to get a very good quality tray that holds three to four pairs of shoes (including boots), but it serves its purpose at the back door.

reviews.t: boot tray - OK for the price
reviews.x: I wasnt expecting much out of a shoe tray that only costs a few bucks. The cost of shipping almost negates the good value. The material is thin and pretty brittle. I ordered two and one was broken by the time I recieved it. I do want to give credit to the vendor who agreed to send me a replacement tray at no additional cost to myself. Ultimatly, I pretty much got what I paid for.

The truth is, I don't actually use these for boots. They're perfect for boots, though. They're very large. Even with my big flat feet I could fit three full size mud kickers on this tray. Which is great after shoveling snow three days in a row. I suppose. Like I said I don't actually use 'em for that. They have other excellent uses. I uses these as trays on my dressers and nightstands. Raise your hand if you're sick and tired of setting down the remote when you're watching TV and later digging i

This is a stiff plastic tray and does what it is supposed to do. I would have preferred a softer rubber. The first one that was sent to me was just put in a large plastic shipping envelope and arrived cracked. It was immediately replaced with a new one - this time with bubble wrap and the plastic envelope. It arrived intact, but I think that was just luck. Either way it can easily crack during shipping, but at least they were efficient in replacing my damaged item. One thing I didn't like was th

I bought these after moving into our new home with hardwood floors. These do a great job of collecting water, dirt, mud and all other junk you might bring in from outside that you don't want tracked on your floor. Shipping took forever, which is why this product gets 4/5 stars. I found something identical at Bed Bath & Beyond (for $7.99) after purchasing these on Amazon. Will buy them at a store next time as shipping just took way too long for me.

My pets are messy eaters and drinkers and I have hardwood floors in the kitchen. Living in south Texas, we don't have snow so I was unable to find boot trays in any stores down here. It works perfectly as a pet placemat.  If they spill water, the raised edges keep it from getting on the hardwood floors. Cost more than I could have bought it for up north but cheaper than resanding the hardwood.

As it says in the title, I use this to contain my dog bowls on my wood floor. It is just about the perfect size. It does a good job of containing small spills, and it doesn't move around too much. It does get pretty dirty, but that is just because having the tray catch the spills allows me to be lazy about cleaning up since I know I don't have to worry about my floor getting ruined.

reviews.t: I bought this boot tray, not for boots, ...
reviews.x: I bought this boot tray, not for boots, but for my cat's litter pan. It's working really well to contain litter that is kicked out of the pan and what sticks to the cat's feet! I actually bought two, so I always have a clean one. Shipping was really quick, and the items were well packaged.

We use this as a tray for our cat food area & water fountain. Our kitten is a water bug and makes a ridiculous mess (likes to stand in the fountain). Now we just need to hose it down or scrub it a bit in the tub and it's good as new.

I love them!  They protect my wood floors from wet and muddy shoes.  I also put felt pads on the bottom of them to protect my floors.  Someday, I'll uprade to really nice, heavy-duty ones... but until then, I'm fine with these.

reviews.t: Love them, I use them under my dog's food ...
reviews.x: Love them, I use them under my dog's food and water bowls.  Works perfectly.  Not sure how they would stand up to heavy boot usage but for dog bowls, exactly what we wanted.
I ordered this not as a boot tray , but as something to set my dogs water bowl on. With 3 large dogs things get messy. Now I don't have to constantly mop up puddles.
I like that this tray is smaller than most of the trays available, but it still fits 3 pairs of women's shoes at a time. It is just right for my small living space.
Save yourself the shipping costs and buy this at your local retail store.  It's a cheap piece of plastic to set your muddy/wet/snowy boots on -- nothing more.
I use this to put my dog's food dishes on. It works great...she makes a mess with the water and the tray keeps it contained. It is also easy to clean.
Awesome. Just what I needed- a shorter boot tray. Most are much longer and don't fit in my cramped entry.

I bought two of these trays for two different uses and have found them to be perfect! They are sturdy and it appears they will last a long time.  I use one under my pet's food and drink containers.  My yorkie has a bad habit of slinging water drops onto the hardwood floor after getting a drink; now the water stays inside the tray.  I used the other one under a tower humidifier that sits on carpet.  Due to "operator" malfunction and a soaked carpet, I set the humidifier on the tray just i

Good product.  I create plywood bases for my power tools so that I can move them around from table to table and clamp them down.  I use these boot tray's underneath the tool (like a grinder) to protect the wood from anything the tool produces and to give one common look for the tools.  It also serves to hold that tool's accessories and power cord.  I can also flip one up against the wall behind the tool to shield the wall from the overspray.  I also use them under the sink to protect the cabinet

It's a boot tray. It shipped intact. No holes, and not broken so there's 4 stars right there. It holds 2 pairs of size 14 shoes/boots and keeps my floor from being an absolute mess. It is pretty stiff, which I know was a complaint from some others about it but my thinking is that if you need to carry it outside to rinse it off or whatever, you don't want a flimsy one possibly folding over and spilling on the floor. It doesn't feel like I could throw baseballs at it but when it's on the floor it

Good tough boot tray, I'm actually going to use it as a good shop drip pan.  Industrial, and if you had it in your home it's just about as low profile as it can be.  If you live in the country (as I do) and your property can get muddy from time to time, first off think about a good cement patio and planting some sod lol, but secondly get a nice boot tray like this one... It'll save your floors.  5 stars for toughness/durablity, timeliness in delivery, and pricing.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the tray works well for its purpose, containing water, mud, and debris with its raised edges and ridges.
Several reviewers note the plastic is thin, stiff, or flimsy, and some would prefer a thicker or softer material.
Some reviewers feel the tray is small or overpriced for what it is.
A number of reviewers use the tray for non-boot purposes such as pet food mats or litter containment.
A few reviewers report shipping issues, including slow delivery or trays arriving cracked, though replacements were provided.
